name: Omarchy Auto Power
author: jfdnet
description: Battery-aware idle power management with stay-awake toggle: suspend-then-hibernate after 10 min idle (systemd RTC hibernates after 20 min) — battery only, skipped on AC power and when stay-awake is enabled.

barWidget.description: Half/full moon toggle for stay-awake (suppress screensaver, lock, suspend and poweroff on idle)
